thread:
maria.g: Heads-up — got a support escalation in staging: several customers hit 429s and a couple reported billing anomalies when quotas reset during a big burst. Can we put together a short internal load-test playbook to pick sane defaults for RPM/TPM and burst window?

maria.g: Example from logs (trimmed):
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z request_id=abcd1234 key=kg_xxx status=429 error=rate_limit_exceeded
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z request_id=abcd1256 key=kg_xxx charge_event=usage_increment tokens=120
```
curl repro:
```bash
for i in {1..300}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"x"}' & done; wait
```

jon.h: Yikes. Two likely things: quota exhaustion + client retry/backoff not respecting 429. Also if billing increments are emitted right when quota refreshes you can double-count transient usage.

jon.h: Can you capture the client-side retry logic + exact timestamps (to correlate usage events)? If not, we'll simulate.

tara.p: Proposal for test matrix (short):
- RPM baselines: 10, 50, 200
- TPM baselines: 500, 2k, 10k
- Burst profiles: steady, 5s spike, 30s spike, sustained 2m
- Measure: 95p latency, 99p latency, 429 rate, billing usage_events per minute, token accounting diffs
- Token reuse/auth expiry: rotate token on ~60s to exercise auth edge cases

ash.sre: Quick k6 snippet to reproduce burst and token rotation:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export let options = { vus: 200, duration: '2m' }; // adjust per matrix
export default function () {
  let token = __ENV.TOKEN; // external script rotates env var between runs
  let r = http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', '{"prompt":"test"}', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
  if (r.status == 429) { /* record 429 */ }
  sleep(0.1);
}
```
Command (single-spike run): `k6 run --vus 500 --duration 30s burst.js`

diego.support: For support escalations, capture these items before slack/eng escalation:
- request_id(s) (full)
- truncated API key prefix (kg_...)
- client library + version + retry/backoff config
- exact client timestamps + tz
- invoice/usage_event IDs if billing mismatch reported

diego.support: With those we can attach evidence to the ticket; engineering will need the rate profile and a trace id to correlate ingest -> billing pipeline.

sre-bot: FYI scheduled internal run: 2026-03-16T09:00Z (testing pool: staging-burst-1). Tags: @eng-infra, @support.

jon.h: Next steps: maria.g to collect missing artifacts (request_ids + client retry config). tara.p and ash.sre to own test matrix implementation. diego.support will prepare support checklist template. We'll run first matrix tomorrow morning and sync results in #eng-infra. :thumbsup:
